bullets: Managed production planning and procurement workflows on SAP ERP, cutting planning cycle time and reducing manual scheduling errors.
Served as SAP Super User for the site, training 10+ cross-departmental staff and acting as first-line support for ERP issues.
Identified workflow inefficiencies through data analysis and proposed process improvements adopted by operations management.
Built and maintained CRM and warehouse management applications on the OutSystems platform, supporting day-to-day business operations.
Delivered a mobile matching application end-to-end — requirements gathering, build, testing and release — as part of a small delivery team.
Partnered directly with business stakeholders to translate functional requirements into working software, running iterative feedback cycles.
